terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.primaryType: 660 litre four-castor moulded plastic refuse container
formLanguage: rectangular tub tapering inward to the base
motionPotential: lid hinges at the rear top edge
objectClass.notes: Rectangular FLAT-SIDED body, not round: the plate was regenerated specifically to kill a domed cylindrical reading. Body tapers INWARD toward the base, opposite to the skip bin. Flat hinged lid with a moulded centre recess and ribbed corner pads; vertical rib pilasters up the walls; four black castors on galvanised forks.

reasoning: One moulded tub dominates; complexity is in the rib pilasters, the lid mouldings and the castor undercarriage.
actionReadinessNeed 2: the lid genuinely hinges, so it must be its own node with a real hinge axis.
repetitionDensity 2: four identical castors and a repeated rib pitch, both folded into the body geometry.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Two draw calls: the body (tub, ribs, rim, castors) merged into one geometry, and the LID as its own mesh because it hinges. That split follows the kit's own wheelie bin, where the lid is a count-1 repetition system for exactly this reason.

detailInventory.note: Each detail maps to a component.localFeatures or material.localOverrides entry.

details.description: The tub tapers INWARD toward the base, so the rim is the widest section and the base the narrowest.
Vertical rib pilasters run up the long walls at a regular pitch, standing proud of the wall face.
A flat lid with a moulded centre recess and ribbed corner pads, hinged along the rear top edge.
A lip runs the full perimeter below the lid and stands proud of the wall.
Four black rubber-tyred castors on galvanised swivel forks, one per corner.
A single saturated dark green across body and lid; the castors are near-black and their forks bare metal.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: The rendered model matches the reference silhouette, primary proportions, visible component hierarchy, material response, and most recognizable local features for the selected fidelity tier.

featureGroups.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
qualityCriteria: Bounding shape, dominant curves, negative spaces, and scale relationships are explicitly described.
failureModes: model reads as a generic placeholder instead of the reference object
major proportions are guessed without evidence

featureGroups.name: Primary structure and hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Major parts, joints, seams, contact points, and parent-child relationships are named before code generation.
failureModes: large visible parts are merged into one mesh
component hierarchy is too shallow for the observed complexity

featureGroups.name: Attachment and joint correctness
qualityCriteria: Every visible child appendage, branch, limb, handle, connector, tube, cable, horn, wing, leg, or hinged part has an attachment contract with parent socket, localStart/localEnd, contact type, embed/overlap, and gap tolerance.
failureModes: child part root floats away from the parent
branch/limb/tube is centered in space instead of pivoting from its root
parent-child transform mixes world and local coordinates

featureGroups.name: Surface material response
qualityCriteria: Albedo zones, roughness, normal/bump/displacement intent, cavity dirt, edge wear, and local overrides are specified where visible.
Important materials define independent albedo, roughness, height/normal, and AO responses instead of reusing one texture for unrelated PBR channels.
Surface response is decomposed into macro, meso, and micro frequency bands with scale and amplitude tied to object scale.
failureModes: local material variation is missing or not tied to image evidence

featureGroups.name: Reference color, material, and lighting response
qualityCriteria: Material-pass names the reference-derived albedo palette, roughness variation, tactile normal/bump/displacement response, and local masks.
When a source image is available, run reference PBR extraction and require confidence >= 0.7 before treating maps as implementation-ready.
Lighting-pass names key/fill/rim or environment light, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadow behavior.
Neutral, grazing-angle, and reference-matched renders prove that surface relief survives relighting and is not painted into albedo.
failureModes: model has acceptable shape but reads as flat shaded or plastic
colors are a generic average instead of reference-observed local color zones
lighting is evenly ambient and cannot reproduce the source value range

visualDeltaChecks: local feature placement and scale delta

Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.

Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.

qualityContract.depthRationale: One macro component plus one count-1 repetition system is the CEILING at 2 draw calls, not a shortfall. The body merges tub, ribs, rim lip and castors; the lid is separate ONLY because it hinges and therefore needs its own node. materialLayers is 1 by the same logic the budget note gives: the green moulding, the black tyres and the bare forks are a colour difference, not a material difference.

mustMatch: reference-derived PBR material response at or above 0.7 confidence when source pixels are usable
niceToHave: micro scratches, stains, chips, and dirt masks

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

featureReviewTargets.name: Rectangular flat-sided body tapering inward
featureReviewTargets.acceptance: Flat sides and a rectangular plan at every azimuth, narrowest at the base. A round or domed reading is the specific failure the plate was regenerated to kill.

featureReviewTargets.name: Flat hinged lid with moulded recess
featureReviewTargets.acceptance: The lid is its own node with a real hinge axis along the rear top edge, and reads flat rather than domed.

featureReviewTargets.name: Four castors on forks
featureReviewTargets.acceptance: Four castors carry the tub clear of the ground as real geometry.

featureReviewTargets.name: Vertical rib pilasters
featureReviewTargets.acceptance: Ribs read as proud vertical pilasters at a regular pitch.

featureReviewTargets.name: Green plastic clear of the backdrop band
featureReviewTargets.acceptance: No face enclosed by the silhouette renders near the harness backdrop's luma 58; the turntable gate must report holed=false.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: The declared 1.37 x 1.22 x 0.78 m is a standard 660 L container and is taken as the contract; the taper ratio is read off the plate.
The body tapers INWARD toward the base - the opposite of the open-top skip bin in this kit, and the thing that most separates the two silhouettes.
The lid hinges along the REAR top edge. The plate shows the hinge knuckles on the far long edge, and the kit's municipal wheelie bin ships the same lid-hinge contract.

Castor swivel is NOT given a pivot. A swivel castor turns about its own vertical stem, but the kit places these as static scenery and a pivot is a promise a game will articulate that part; the lid is the one mechanism worth the contract.
The rear and left faces are not visible in the single view and are built by symmetry with the front and right. Confidence 0.7.
The moulded lettering and the small hinge hardware on the lid are below the resolvable band at prop distance and are not modelled.

coordinateFrame.notes: Origin base-center on the ground (the castors' contact point is y=0), +Y up, +Z the front wall.

silhouette.description: Castors r 0.075 from y 0 to 0.15. Tub from y 0.15 (1.15 x 0.60) to the rim at y 1.00 (1.37 x 0.78), tapering INWARD toward the base, corners radiused 0.06. A rim lip stands 0.018 proud over y 1.00-1.05. The lid sits y 1.05-1.22, hinged along the rear (-Z) top edge.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: The declared 1.37 x 1.22 x 0.78 m is a standard 660 L container and is taken as the contract. The taper is read off the plate's near corner, where the base reads about 0.84 of the rim width.

aspectRatios.note: the inward taper, read off the plate

silhouette.symmetry: bilateral about the x and z axes; the lid hinge breaks front-back symmetry
dominantCurves: 0.06 m radius on each vertical corner
negativeSpaces: the gap under the tub between the four castors
the shadow line under the rim lip

componentTree.name: Tub, rib pilasters, rim lip and castors
componentTree.topologyRationale: A moulded tub whose walls taper inward to the base, with the ribs, rim lip and castor undercarriage merged into the same geometry. They are one moulding in reality and one draw call here; a part hung off its own pivot could never be merged afterwards.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Rounded-rectangle rings lofted from the base 1.15 x 0.60 at y 0.15 to the rim 1.37 x 0.78 at y 1.00, corner radius 0.06, 20 points per ring; a rim lip band 0.018 proud over y 1.00-1.05; an interior returning to a floor at y 0.30; five rib pilasters per long wall standing 0.012 proud; four castors as an 8-segment tyre cylinder r 0.075 on a fork box, at the four corners.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: Nothing is flush and co-facing. The rib pilasters stand 0.012 PROUD of the wall they sit on; the rim lip stands 0.018 proud of the wall head; each fork meets the tub underside as OPPOSED faces, an ordinary butt joint.
geometryDescriptor.mergeNote: One merged BufferGeometry with a colour written for EVERY vertex - a vertexColors material renders BLACK on any geometry missing the attribute.

localFeatures.description: walls tapering inward to the base
localFeatures.delivery: loft between a smaller foot ring and a larger rim ring

localFeatures.description: vertical ribs up the long walls
localFeatures.delivery: merged proud boxes at a regular pitch
merged tyre cylinders and fork boxes

localFeatures.description: flat hinged lid with a moulded centre recess
localFeatures.delivery: count-1 repetition system on its own hinge node

colorMaterialRecipe.recipe: Vertex colour on one material: green #5c7d62 across tub, ribs, rim and lid; tyres #3b3b3b; forks #8d8f92.

pivot.name: root
pivot.notes: At base-center, the origin the asset declares.

collider.notes: Authoring intent only; thaikit derives the shipped compound from the built geometry.

destruction.notes: Not breakable - the asset declares no destruction groups.

roughness.notes: Moulded polyethylene has a satin sheen, lower roughness than the skip bin's oxidised steel. Scalar is the runtime value; textureless.

albedo.samplingNotes: crops/body.png measured #46624c at luma 90.4, saturation 0.281. Authored at #5c7d62, luma 118. Rotomoulded polyethylene is a dielectric, so metalness is 0 across the whole prop including the castor tyres.

localOverrides.region: tub, ribs, rim lip and lid
localOverrides.evidence: LIFTED with the arithmetic stated. Measured #46624c at luma 90.4: a side-lit face renders at ~0.56 of its painted luma, so 90.4 would land at 51 - BELOW the harness backdrop's 58 - and the silhouette gate reads a face at the backdrop's luma as a hole. The measured saturation of 0.281 is already above the 0.26 the chroma route needs, so the hue carries most of the separation; the value is lifted to 118 as well, landing near 66 side-lit, so the prop clears the gate on BOTH chroma and luma rather than relying on one.

crops/castor.png measured #6b6c68 at luma 107, but that crop straddles tyre and backdrop. The tyre is authored at #3b3b3b, luma 59 - deliberately dark because a castor is a small part at the silhouette's bottom edge, well inside the footprint, and the turntable gate is verified against the built render rather than assumed.
Galvanised steel fork, read off the plate as a near-neutral mid grey above each tyre.

evidence: crops/body.png measured #46624c; one saturated green across the whole moulding, which is what a rotomoulded bin IS - the colour is in the polymer, not printed on it.
The identity is the rectangular flat-sided taper, the rib pilasters and the lid, every one of them geometry. There is no pattern to resolve at prop distance.
Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet, and so the generator does not force color to white and roughness to 1 and discard this measured albedo.
textureless.note: No textureResolution, referencePbr, textureProjection or surfaceFrequencyBands.

repetitionSystems.name: Hinged lid

instances.hinge: rear top edge at z -0.39, axis +X

repetitionSystems.placement: One lid spanning the full rim, hinged along the rear top edge at z -0.39 on the +X axis.

attachment.notes: The lid's skirt laps OVER the rim lip rather than butting flush to it, so no two co-facing surfaces are coincident.

repetitionSystems.notes: Count 1, and it is a repetition system rather than a second component for the reason the kit's own wheelie bin records: the draw-call accounting counts components and repetition systems alike, and this way the lid keeps its own mesh and its own hinge node inside a ceiling of two.

Each important material defines roughness variation and at least one normal/bump/displacement response.
Local material overrides, dirt/wear/stains/moss/chips/scratches or equivalent masks are tied to evidenceRefs.
Thin, transparent, reflective, wet, or fibrous materials document alpha/transmission/clearcoat/metalness/fiber response when relevant.

AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make material and form readable under neutral turntable lighting plus optional reference lighting.
acceptance: lightingFromPhoto identifies key light direction/color/intensity, fill light, rim or environment light, and ambient color.
Exposure, tone mapping, background color/gradient, shadow softness, and contact shadow behavior are specified.
Lighting does not hide geometry/material gaps and screenshots can be compared fairly to the reference.
Neutral, grazing, and reference-matched lighting checks distinguish material errors from lighting errors.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make the model ready for future animation, transformation, physics, or destruction.
acceptance: Macro and movable meso components have stable pivot nodes.
Sockets, collider proxies, and destruction metadata are present for future runtime actions.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Protect runtime performance after visual fidelity is accepted.
acceptance: Triangle count, draw calls, instancing, LOD strategy, and FPS target are documented or verified.
Repeated detail is instanced or simplified where possible without breaking silhouette/material believability.

featureReviews.notes: Flat-sided and rectangular at every azimuth, narrowest at the base. Built envelope measures 1.370 x 1.220 x 0.780 m against the declared 1.37 x 1.22 x 0.78 - exact on all three axes after the rim lip was pulled in, since the LIP and not the wall head is the widest point and it was carrying the prop 2.6% over. The round-domed reading the plate was regenerated to kill does not occur.

The lid is its own mesh on its own hinge node, positioned on the real hinge line at the rear top edge and turning on +X, so rotating that one node opens it. Reads flat with a moulded centre recess standing proud. Simplified against the plate: the lid's ribbed corner pads and hinge knuckles are not modelled, being below the resolvable band at prop distance.

Four castors as 8-segment tyre discs on fork boxes, merged into the body geometry, carrying the tub clear of the ground. Simplified: the swivel plate and axle bolt are not modelled, and the castors are not given pivots because the kit places these as static scenery.
Five ribs per long wall at a regular pitch, standing 12 mm proud of the wall face they sit on rather than flush with it.

The measured #46624c (luma 90.4) was LIFTED to #5c7d62 (luma 118) because a side-lit face renders at ~0.56 of painted luma and 90.4 would land at 51, below the harness backdrop's 58. Saturation is held at 0.26+ so the prop clears on chroma as well as value. The turntable gate confirms it: holed=false at all four azimuths, segmentation reliable.

reviewHistory.summary: 520 triangles / 2 draw calls / 1 material / 2 unique geometries against 2000 / 2 / 2 / 4. The split was decided in the blockout: everything that does not move is merged, and only the lid is separate.

featureReviews.evidence: A flat-sided rectangular tub tapering inward toward the base, 0.94 x 1.22 x 0.78 m, standing on four castors.
featureReviews.notes: WIDTH CORRECTED from 1.37 m to 0.94 m. The declaration was a list-time estimate and made the bin half again as wide as it should be against its own depth. The Meshy proxy's band table read width/height 0.65-0.76 across bands 2-9 against the build's 0.94-1.09 -- eight of ten bands over the 0.12 flag, mean |delta width| 0.34 -- while reading DEPTH at 0.50-0.62 against the build's 0.55-0.64, already right. An error in ONE axis is a declaration error, not a scale one. The plate agrees independently: read as a 3/4 view at ~30 degrees yaw its front face spans ~620 px and its side ~300, so true width/depth is (620/cos30)/(300/sin30) = 1.19, against the proxy's 1.23 and the build's 1.76. After the correction the band table reads mean |delta width| 0.0235 and mean |delta depth| 0.0540, with NO band over the flag.

featureReviews.evidence: Five moulded channels up each long wall, running from 0.22 m to 0.88 m and stopping below the rim so the two front lugs sit clear above them.
featureReviews.notes: THE WALL TAPERS, SO A STRAIGHT BOX CANNOT SIT ON IT, and that -- not the amount of relief -- is why these read as scratches before. The old build placed one box per rib at the wall depth of its own MIDPOINT, so each rib was buried in the wall over its top half and standing off it over the bottom half, rendering as a fin with a step in it that stopped short at both ends. A stack of four short boxes was tried next and is worse: it steps by the full taper per segment, 18 mm here, which renders as an unmistakable staircase, and more segments only makes the staircase finer. They are single tapered prisms now (Soup.wallRib), whose outer face is parallel to the wall by construction. Relief also doubled, 12 mm to 26 mm.

featureReviews.evidence: A two-step lid overhanging the body by 35 mm all round, with a raised centre panel and five-bar diagonal grip ribbing at each of the four corners; its own node, hinged along the rear top edge.
featureReviews.notes: It was a plain slab with one thin strip, which reads as a closed box rather than as a lid. The plate shows a stepped lid with a clear shadow gap under its edge on every side, a large centre panel inside a raised border, and diagonal grip ribbing at the corners -- which is most of what identifies a bin lid seen from above, and this prop is nearly always seen from above in a level. The centre panel and the grip bars both stand PROUD rather than being sunk: sunk, their top faces would share the lid top's plane facing the same way and tear into interleaved triangles as the camera moves.

featureReviews.evidence: Four swivel castors at the corners, wheel radius raised from 0.075 to 0.085 m, carrying the tub clear of the ground.
featureReviews.notes: Unchanged in construction; enlarged so the undercarriage is legible at prop distance, where it was previously four dark specks. The forks stay schematic -- at 2 draw calls and 2 materials for this class there is no budget for a jointed castor and no distance at which it would be seen.

featureReviews.evidence: Moulded plastic at #5c7d62, measured #46624c and lifted to luma 118 with saturation held above 0.26.
featureReviews.notes: Unchanged. The measurement is lifted because a side-lit face renders at ~0.56 of its painted luma, which would land the measured value at 51 against the harness backdrop's 58 and read as a hole; saturation is held so the prop clears the gate on chroma as well as value.

reviewHistory.summary: Rebuild 2026-08-31. Width corrected 1.37 -> 0.94 m against the Meshy band table and an independent 3/4 plate read, which agree at width/depth 1.23 and 1.19 against the build's 1.76; mean |delta width| 0.34 -> 0.0235 with no band left over the 0.12 flag. Rib pilasters rebuilt as single tapered prisms after a straight box and then a four-box stack both failed visibly on a leaning wall. Lid rebuilt as a two-step overhanging form with a raised centre panel and corner grip ribbing. Castors enlarged, front lugs added. 796/2000 triangles, 2/2 draw calls, 1/2 materials, 2/4 unique geometries; turntable passes at all four azimuths with no holes and check-coplanar is clean.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented.

drawCalls.note: Body (tub, ribs, rim lip, castors) as ONE merged geometry, plus the lid as its own mesh because it hinges: 2 of 2.

materials.note: ONE material for the whole prop. The green body, the near-black castor tyres and their bare-metal forks are a COLOUR difference, not a material difference, so they ride vertex colours. The spare slot is left unspent deliberately: a second material is a shader switch on a prop a level builder places by the dozen.

uniqueGeometries.note: One merged body geometry and one lid geometry.

triangles.note: Measured after the render and recorded here.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: Read off the plate's lit-to-shadow ratio.
Fill ratio taken from the measured lit-face to shadow-face luma ratio.

lightingFromPhoto.source: uniform light grey studio surround measured off the plate corners
lightingFromPhoto.notes: The seamless backdrop acts as a large source.

lightingFromPhoto.contactShadow: A soft ground shadow beneath the castors only; the plate shows no hard cast shadow.
lightingFromPhoto.ambientOcclusion: Contact occlusion in the recesses and under overhangs; lighting, never painted into base colour.
lightingFromPhoto.notes: Exposure and tone mapping intent recorded so a render compares fairly with the plate. No baked lighting or AO enters any albedo.

proceduralStrategy: Create stable pivot groups, sockets, collider proxies, and destruction metadata before visual polish.
Refine forms with bevels, tapers, bends, and procedural noise.
Run reference PBR extraction for important source-image materials and stop when confidence is below the target threshold.
Add material variation before adding expensive micro-geometry.
animationAnchors: root pivot node supports whole-object translation, rotation, scale, and visibility changes
component pivot groups support later local transforms without rebuilding geometry
destructionAnchors: actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup marks detachable or breakable component sets
component seams and sockets define plausible break points instead of random explosions
